The operational check should be carried out for three accelerator potentiometer pedal positions.

P, 0° (idle) P1, 0° - 70° (operating range) P2, 88° (internal mechanical stop)

Make sure that the ignition is in the OFF position, then disconnect the negative battery terminal (refer to op. 5530B10 ).

Disconnect the electrical connection from the accelerator pedal potentiometer.

Name

Connector

-

Accelerator pedal potentiometer

K55

Check that the voltage ratio measured between pins 1-3 and 2-3, in the three angular positions 88°, 70°, 0°, is 0.95 ± 0.04, 0.786 ± 0.04, 0.15 ± 0.01, respectively.

Check that the voltage ratio measured between pins 4-6 and 5-6, at the three angular positions 88°, 70°, 0°, is 0.475 ± 0.06, 0.393 ± 0.06, 0.075 ± 0.02, respectively.
